summary: The proposed change adds a necessary permission check for the 'save_as_new' functionality, but it may introduce behavioral regression if the intent was to allow saving as new based on change permissions.

issues.description: The change modifies the condition to require 'has_add_permission' instead of 'has_change_permission', which could break existing behavior where users with change permissions but not add permissions were allowed to use 'save_as_new'.
